verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer versioning, review and rollback of deployed servers or trigger-based automations, so the axis applies. The pack only documents connections, triggers, publishing, namespaces and CLI registry/tool commands. Nothing shows versioning, review workflows, or rollback of automations or server deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
